label: Two-factor authentication required
means: Whether the org requires two-factor authentication of every member and outside collaborator.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Requiring two-factor authentication in your organization (https://docs.github.com/en/organizations/keeping-your-organization-secure/managing-two-factor-authentication-for-your-organization/requiring-two-factor-authentication-in-your-organization, read 2026-11-26)
source: state: gh api orgs/<owner>: two_factor_requirement_enabled; not measured without an org owner's admin:org token

params.comment: owner: the GitHub org read; empty means the quality config's owner.

label: Security configuration for new repos
means: Whether a code security configuration is the default for new public and private repos.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, REST API endpoints for code security settings (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/code-security/configurations, read 2026-11-26): a default configuration applies to each new repo
source: state: gh api orgs/<owner>/code-security/configurations/defaults: default_for_new_repos is all, or both public and private_and_internal

label: One read
means: Seconds this tab's collector takes to read the org's security settings.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Best practices for using the REST API (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/best-practices-for-using-the-rest-api, read 2026-11-26), asks for serial requests; template goal: a few serial reads finish in seconds
source: wall time of this tab's collector, first request to last

label: API requests per read
means: gh api requests one read of the org's security settings spends.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Rate limits for the REST API (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api, read 2026-11-26): GITHUB_TOKEN gets 1,000 requests per hour per repository; template goal: one read spends a hundredth of that
source: gh api requests this tab's collector made, one per page
